No explicit jewellery/gold (MCC 5944/5094) exclusion or jewellery-specific cap found in HDFC MITC v4.13 or reward T&Cs for Infinia, Diners Black, Regalia, Regalia Gold, MoneyBack+, Freedom, Diners Privilege; jewellery earn is inferred (absence of exclusion). Swiggy cards, IndianOil and Millennia-style exclusions were explicit. Third-party claims of a Regalia Gold 'digital_gold' exclusion not confirmed.

Infinia/Diners Black SmartBuy accelerated points on Tanishq vouchers: rate and monthly accelerated caps not confirmed (one aggregator says gold/jewellery excluded from SmartBuy bonus rewards, unverified).

Forex markup not found for Millennia, Swiggy cards, Tata Neu cards, MoneyBack+, Freedom, Pixel, IndianOil, Marriott (MITC fee table layout is garbled in text extraction). Product pages give 2% Infinia/Diners Black/Regalia Gold, 3.5% Regalia/Diners Privilege.
Marriott Bonvoy point rupee value and fee waiver threshold not published; base_rate omitted. IndianOil base_rate omitted (Fuel Point value unclear).

Not covered (no detailed data collected): Regalia First, Regalia Activ, Diners Club Miles/Rewardz/Premium, Doctor's Regalia, IRCTC, PhonePe Ultimo/Uno, Shoppers Stop, Pine Labs, UPI RuPay, Times, Superia, Paytm, business cards (BizBlack, BizPower, etc.). BizPower 15 May 2026 changes (5 RP/Rs200, IT/GST first-2-transactions rule, 5X cap 7,500 RP) seen only on third-party blog.

Rupee values of CashPoints/RP are redemption-dependent; rates assume the best stated common redemption (Infinia/Diners Black Rs1/RP on SmartBuy travel and Tanishq vouchers; Regalia family Rs0.50/RP) - lower for cashback redemption.

15 May 2026 changes confirmed officially for Regalia Gold (5 RP/Rs200) and Diners Privilege (4 RP/Rs200); BizPower and 'all other cards' scope from third-party only. Quarterly Rs60,000-spend lounge rule applies from 1 Jul 2026.
No HDFC Zoho, Harley-Davidson (separate from H.O.G) or Titan/Tanishq co-brand card found; Zoho search returned nothing. Titan card is issued by SBI.
Forex markups missing for most new cards; reward point values missing for several legacy cards (Platinum Plus, Platinum Edge, All Miles, Superia, Doctor's Superia, Platinum Times).
Business 5X/10X accelerated rules (BizBlack, BizPower, BizFirst EMI 3%) not modelled numerically because multiplier basis is unclear.
Shoppers Stop (mass) 3% earn rate and point value are aggregator-only; Shoppers Stop Black point value assumed Re1.
Percent CashPoint cards (UPI RuPay, BizFirst, GIGA) modelled at stated CP rupee values, conservatively; headline percentages may overstate value.
Paytm HDFC cards rely on a 2023 notice; consumer Paytm cards, Business MoneyBack, InterMiles Signature, Purchase Reward Card and AP/AR/Fleet/TMC/Central Travel programmes not detailed.
FD-backed Pixel FAQ PDF could not be parsed (no pypdf/pdftotext); FD card terms inferred. Other FD-backed variants (Millennia, MoneyBack+, Regalia Gold per aggregators) not separately catalogued.
Status for Regalia Activ, Doctor's Regalia, Doctor's Superia is unknown: pages live without closure notice but absent from current listing.
Network values come from cardadvisor.in and issuer notes; several cards are issued on two networks (Tata Neu, IndianOil, Pixel).
